# NX Serve (full)

> NX Serve is a Saudi white-label platform for launching on-demand service businesses (towing, logistics, home services) with Moyasar split payments, live tracking and an API. It is configurable and multi-tenant: services, prices and workflows are edited in a console as data, with no app release.

## What it is
NX Serve is sold as white-label licences to entrepreneurs and companies who launch their own branded service business on it. Towing is the first template; moving, AC and home maintenance, cleaning, mobile car wash, vehicle inspection and more run as templates on the same engine.

## How it works
1. Sign up and pick a branded subdomain.
2. Choose a ready template (towing, logistics).
3. Brand it: logo, colors, domain and bilingual copy.
4. Connect Moyasar so money reaches each recipient directly.
5. Onboard providers with registration, documents, verification and per-category approval.
6. Go live on the web; add branded iOS and Android apps on the Advanced plan.

## Key facts
- Money flows from Moyasar directly to each recipient via split payments. The platform never holds third-party funds, and card data never touches its servers.
- Services, categories, dynamic fields, workflows, stages and pricing are data, edited in the console. A new service needs zero code changes.
- Every state change is realtime: live tracking, order status and ops dashboards.
- Bilingual Arabic and English at full parity, right to left designed. Global-ready through country packs, Saudi first.
- Compliance: ZATCA e-invoicing, PDPL data protection, Nafath and KYB verification.
- API platform: documented /v1 with OpenAPI, test and live keys, signed webhooks, an SDK and a developer portal.

## Plans
- Basic: web storefront, ordering, tracking, provider portal, one template.
- Growth: zones, advanced pricing, analytics, multiple services.
- Advanced: branded store apps, custom domain, full API access.
- Enterprise: SLA, custom integrations, account manager.
